label: Glencoe Road / Whycocomagh Port Hood Road junction
phase: Fresh expansion of unchanged affine4 validation; no fitting or model-selection use
point_definition: Centre of the identified three-road meeting, paired with the centreline reference node. The stated observation uncertainty allows for local engineering and cartographic differences; their size is not independently measured, and uncertainty is not subtracted from residuals.
identity_evidence: The source main road approaches from the northwest and turns northeast at the junction north of Glencoe. A third road leaves southeast, bends south by the stream, and meets the lower alternate western approach farther downstream. The provincial reference has the same three-way meeting, initial southeast/south bend and downstream road/stream loop. The neighbouring upper road junction northeast of this site is a different feature. The point is measured on the road meeting north of the Glencoe label.
unscored_definition_revision: Clarified that uncertainty is an allowance, not a verified bound on engineering differences. Source and reference coordinates are unchanged; original unscored wording retained.
